checks.name: authentication and role guards protect Princess APIs

production retries reuse one ledger credit and generated reference
baseline is initial-only; external receipts and retries have distinct safe semantics
stock and numeric validation rejects overselling without partial rows
sales consume the branch batches earliest-best-before first
online retries return the same sale and conflicting references are rejected
server queued sales do not affect stock; partial sync retains failed records
the same queued reference promotes to a confirmed sale exactly once
closing rejects duplicate products, missing products and blank physical counts
pending sales block closing; submitting does not adjust stock
historical summary ignores later stock movements
submitted expected and variance remain frozen after owner adjustments
business date override aligns new sale, ledger and daily summary
staff cannot switch branches; owner queries require explicit branch selection
signed next opening uses final confirmed closing, never the current live ledger
sales belonging to a signed week cannot post or synchronize
activity failure rolls back the sale and its stock movements together
fully sold stock remains visible as a zero-stock alert
legacy owner product URLs share the same validation without changing account actions
offline entries survive new reads and stay isolated by user and branch
queue references fit the server limit and are unique
enqueue retry is idempotent; conflicting contents are rejected
failure retains exact sale and original timestamp for a safe replay
unavailable device storage never reports that the sale was queued
corrupt data is reported and never silently erased
invalid local quantities are rejected before writing
